issuer: the Georgia Department of Driver Services (DDS)
note: DDS's fees and terms page (read 2026-10-30) gives a regular licence for 8 years at $32 and a Georgia ID card for 8 years at $32 (a voter ID card is free). The teen drivers page says a full, unrestricted Class C licence is granted from 18 (a Class D provisional licence before), so it is kept from 18. No youngest age for the card was read.

sources.title: Georgia DDS, Fees and Terms
sources.said: Regular Driver's License (Class A, B, C, E, F, M) 8 Years $32 ... Georgia ID Card 8 Years $32

sources.title: Georgia DDS, Teen Drivers
sources.said: A full, unrestricted Class C driver’s license is granted to individuals aged 18 and older
